Oakfield Primary Judo Club
Come and join us…

We would like to invite pupils to join our new after-school judo club, starting from Wednesday 7th October 2026.
Classes teach throws, holds and safe falling, plus fitness and confidence.

Dates are from Wednesday 7th October to Wednesday 9th December, with a half-term break on Oct 28th (no lesson).
Cost: £72 for the 9 lessons.
A judo suit isn't needed at first, but each pupil will need one eventually. Suits cost £20.

To book a place or ask a question, contact Coach Sam at coach@example.com.
